# Youhanna Meleka

> Food scarcity is an engineering problem. Youhanna Meleka is co-founder and CEO of Ficio, where the team builds embodied AI for the food supply chain.

Site: https://ymeleka.com/
Places gallery: https://ymeleka.com/places

## About
Started a business at 14 and was on a factory floor at 16. Studied industrial, manufacturing and systems engineering at Penn State. Managed 50+ suppliers end-to-end across 12 countries at Tesla (electro-mechanical assemblies, actuators, exterior lighting and more; recognized by Elon Musk as Tesla Top Talent). Now researches wide-bandgap semiconductors at Cornell University in the Jena-Xing Lab.

Interested in emerging technologies and their applications to improve the world: AI infrastructure (chips, models, edge compute and applications). Leads technical programs at Cornell University Physical Intelligence. Evaluates companies, develops investment theses and does market research at Big Red Ventures.

## Work
- Ficio (https://www.ficio.org): co-founder and CEO. Embodied AI for the food supply chain, starting with in-field apple harvesting and sorting robots.
- Cornell University: wide-bandgap semiconductor research in the Jena-Xing Lab (https://jena-xing.engineering.cornell.edu).
- Big Red Ventures (https://www.brventurefund.com/): deep tech diligence, investment theses and market research.
- Cornell University Physical Intelligence (https://cornellphysicalintelligence.com): founding board member; leads technical programs.
- Penn State (https://www.psu.edu/): B.S., industrial, manufacturing and systems engineering.
